subject: Custom alert rule request
body: Trying to build an alert that combines two conditions with an OR rather than AND, took a bit of back and forth to get the logic right but got there in the end, thanks.

subject: Dashboard tile ordering not saving

subject: Dashboard performance on mobile
body: Dashboards are noticeably slower to load on the mobile app than on desktop. Not a blocker, just noticed it's gotten more sluggish recently.

subject: Feature request: alert escalation chain
body: Would be great if an unacknowledged alert could escalate to a second recipient after a set time, useful for our on-call rotation.

subject: Feature request: webhook signature verification

subject: Alert acknowledgement not syncing to mobile

subject: API authentication token expiry

I've tried everything suggested in your documentation. Please escalate if needed — we need this resolved. Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Dashboard loading extremely slowly
body: Our main finance dashboard has been taking 30–45 seconds to load since the new year. It was fine before. Nothing has changed on our end. This is not workable for daily use.

subject: Connector sync failures — again
body: Connector down again. This is the third time this year. No error details, just 'sync failed'. We have submitted tickets each time and the fixes don't hold. Need a permanent solution, not another workaround. Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Dashboard no longer loads for one user
body: One of our users cannot load any dashboards — the screen just shows a spinner indefinitely. Other users on the same account are fine. I've asked them to clear the browser cache and try a different browser but the issue remains. Please advise. Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Dashboard access for external auditor
body: We need to give a time-limited, read-only dashboard link to an external auditor. Is there a way to do this without creating a full user account?

subject: Alert configured on wrong metric
body: One of our alerts appears to be monitoring gross revenue instead of net, despite being configured for net. Could be a display issue rather than the underlying calculation.

subject: Export access for new auditor
body: Following on from the access question at year-end, this year's auditor also needs export capability, not just view access. Can we set this up the same way as before?

subject: Adding a rolling 12-month view to finance dashboard
body: We'd like to add a rolling 12-month trend view to our main finance dashboard alongside the current fixed calendar-year one, so we can see performance without waiting for January resets each year. Is this something we can configure ourselves in the dashboard builder, or does it need a custom widget on your side? Happy to share the specific metrics if that helps scope it.

subject: API authentication token expiring early
body: Our integration's API token has started expiring after roughly six hours instead of the 24 documented, which means our overnight jobs fail partway through and someone has to manually re-authenticate each morning before the numbers are ready. This has happened four mornings out of the last ten. Could you check whether something changed on the token issuance side recently?

subject: Alerts module - notifications arriving hours late
body: Since May, our budget alerts have been arriving three to four hours after the threshold was actually crossed rather than close to real time, which defeats the point of having them at all for same-day decisions. We've flagged this internally twice now. A couple of the team have gone back to checking figures manually in Excel each afternoon rather than relying on the alerts, which isn't really where we want to be given what we pay for this module. Could this get proper attention rather than a quick patch?

subject: Exported files opening with formatting stripped
body: Scheduled exports to Excel have started losing all number formatting - currency symbols, decimal places, everything reverts to plain numbers on open, since around the start of July. It means every recipient has to reformat manually before the file's usable. Given the alerts issue from a few weeks back, it's been a bit of a run of small things lately. We can live with reformatting manually for now, but wanted to flag it while it's fresh.

subject: Alerts still delayed - following up from June
body: Following up on the alert timing issue from June - notifications are still arriving two to three hours late most days, so the fix doesn't seem to have held. We've settled into manually checking the figures in Excel each afternoon as our real safety net at this point, so there's no immediate pressure to resolve this quickly. Wanted to keep it on record in case it's useful context for whatever's happening underneath.

subject: Report template not saving
body: Hi, I created a report template and saved it, but it's not appearing in the templates list for other users on our account. It shows in my own view. Is there a sharing step I'm missing, or is this a bug? Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: HubSpot connector not syncing
body: Hello, our HubSpot connector stopped syncing two days ago. The status shows 'connected' but the last successful sync was 23 November. We haven't changed any HubSpot permissions. Could you investigate? Maria Heikkinen

subject: Alert condition builder — AND logic not working
body: Hi, I'm trying to set up an alert that fires only when two conditions are both true (metric A above threshold AND metric B below threshold). When I add both conditions the alert seems to fire on either condition being met individually, not both together. Is the AND logic functioning correctly? Maria Heikkinen

subject: API response time degraded
body: Hello, we've noticed that API response times have increased significantly since the start of the year. Calls that were completing in under a second are now taking 3–5 seconds. We haven't changed our query structure. Is there known degradation on the platform, or could this be related to our account configuration? Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: Export formatting broken in Excel output
body: The Excel exports we download are coming out with columns merged incorrectly and date fields formatted as plain text rather than dates. This is making post-processing the files much more work than it should be. Also still waiting on a response to ticket #2 from November regarding the HubSpot connector. Maria Heikkinen

subject: API calls dropping intermittently
body: Hello, we're seeing intermittent dropped API calls — requests go out, no error is returned, but no data comes back either. It's happening roughly 10–15% of the time and we can't identify a pattern. We've had to add retry logic to our integration as a workaround but this isn't sustainable. The issue was flagged to your team in January as well. Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: API still unreliable — following up
body: Still seeing dropped API calls after the fix applied last week. The rate has reduced but not stopped. We need this fully resolved, not partially. This has been ongoing since January. Maria Heikkinen

subject: User permissions resetting on login
body: Hello, we've had two users report that their custom permission settings are reverting to defaults each time they log in. We set the permissions at the admin level and they save correctly, but by the next session they're back to default. This is causing access issues. Could you look into it? Maria Heikkinen

subject: Three connectors failed simultaneously
body: All three of our active connectors failed at the same time this morning. This cannot be a coincidence and suggests a platform-level issue. We've had repeated connector problems since November. This needs to be looked at properly, not just restarted. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Dashboard widgets showing stale data
body: Dashboard is showing data from yesterday even though the connectors show last sync as this morning. Refresh doesn't help. Fix this please — we've had too many data reliability issues this year. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Report builder crashing on large datasets
body: Report builder crashes the browser tab when I try to preview a report with more than about 5,000 rows. This dataset isn't large by any normal standard. No error message, just a blank tab. Completely unusable for our monthly reports. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Alerts not firing at all
body: None of our alerts have fired since 9 May. Zero notifications. Conditions are definitely being met. This has happened before and it takes too long to get fixed. We're having to check the dashboards manually every day. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Dashboard filter options disappeared
body: Hello, the filter panel on two of our dashboards is no longer showing any options — it's just empty. The filters were working last week. I've checked the configuration and nothing appears to have changed. Could you take a look? We'll work from exports in the meantime. Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: Alert delivery delay — over 4 hours
body: Hello, when alerts do fire now they're arriving 3–5 hours after the condition is met. For time-sensitive thresholds this makes the alerts effectively useless. We've been through enough of these issues that I'm not going to say we expect an immediate fix — but I would like to understand whether there's a structural reason for this and what the realistic timeline for resolution is. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Dashboard not loading for new user
body: New team member can't load any dashboards — just a loading spinner. Other users are fine. Please sort this out. Maria Heikkinen

subject: API pull timing out intermittently

subject: Re: API timeouts - still happening
body: Following up on the timeout issue from last month - it hasn't gone away, if anything it's worse this week. We've had three failed nightly pulls since Monday. Need an actual fix, not another 'we're looking into it'.

subject: Export broken again

We use these dashboards in board meetings, so if the numbers are wrong once more it's a real problem for us.

subject: API down again

We've asked our CFO's office to hold off using Kataja numbers for the January review until this is sorted. We've raised six tickets since summer on essentially three recurring problems - exports, API, dashboards - and I'd like to talk to someone above first-line support about what's actually being done long-term, not ticket by ticket.

subject: Alert thresholds not firing - escalating

subject: Exports failing again, mid-review

subject: Seat count discrepancy after the review

subject: Export scheduling shifted an hour

subject: Report builder - rolling average formula

Is this a known issue with the report builder, or something specific to templates built from an older version?

subject: API response times degrading under normal load

It's starting to push into the finance team's morning prep time. We've begun quietly benchmarking Storsund BI's API alongside this as part of general due diligence, mostly because we'd like to understand whether this kind of slowdown is a one-off or a pattern worth planning around.

subject: API slowdown - still unresolved from March
body: Coming back to the response-time issue from March - it never really returned to normal, it's held steady at roughly 10-12 minutes for the nightly pull rather than getting worse, so we adjusted our job scheduling to start earlier and absorb the delay. That's working fine for us operationally, so there's no need to prioritise this above other things, but wanted to note that whatever was flagged in March doesn't appear to have been resolved.
